trend_strength.description: Measures how strongly the topic is currently being discussed across available sources.

search_intent.description: Measures whether users are likely to actively search for information about the topic.

freshness.description: Measures how recent and time-sensitive the topic is.

french_relevance.description: Measures how relevant the topic is to French-speaking gamers and search audiences.

competition.description: Measures GamerQuest's realistic ability to compete for the opportunity. Lower SEO competition receives more points.

gamerquest_relevance.description: Measures how closely the topic fits GamerQuest's gaming editorial focus.
